title: We Are More Than Just Crypto: Coinbase's VanGrack
description:
Ryan VanGrack, vice chair and head of corporate affairs at Coinbase, joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss Coinbase taking the first regulatory step toward letting US investors make leveraged, round-the-clock bets on stocks without owning them. VanGrack also talked about US regulation and Anthony Armstrong joining Coinbase.
